guidance.offerExplanation: Math offers begin in January. Most arrive in May. A quiet March does not settle your application.
guidance.foundation: Six eligible Grade 12 U/M courses, including Advanced Functions, Calculus and Vectors, a 4U English course, and another 4U course. Prerequisites are included in your top-six average. AIF required for these programs.
guidance.checklist: The Math faculty currently lists the DAE, AIF and SIF with transcripts. Follow the requirements and due dates in your applicant portal. For September 2027, repeated courses use the highest grade without penalty; accredited summer, night, online and private-school courses also carry no penalty.
guidance.earlyOffers: The Faculty says most applicants hear in mid-May once it has recent grades and a scored AIF. The general Math window runs January–May. CFM’s published guidance describes very few February or March early offers, reserved for exceptional circumstances, with most offers in May. These are broad timing statements, not a guaranteed 2027 round calendar.
guidance.majorRoute: Apply through Mathematics, then select Mathematical Finance at the end of first year. It is shown here as a later major, so it does not get a separate first-year offer series.
